name: Kongu Engineering College (KEC)
summary: Kongu Engineering College, at Perundurai near Erode, was established in 1984 under the Kongu Vellalar Institute of Technology Trust with three UG branches and 180 students; it now has over 8,250 students on a 167-acre campus. It is affiliated to Anna University, autonomous since 2007 (status valid till 2033) and accredited A++ by NAAC.
